scope: Original CPU NumPy ports of one-layer equations, with full-batch Fisher refreshed every step (skip S=1). RENG uses analytic Hessian-vector double-backprop. Exact model Fisher replaces sampled model labels; no inverse-update approximation. AdaFisher constant-block convention documented. Fixed transparent rates, not equal-FLOP or tuned universal optimizer ranking; no large-model reproduction.

environment.scope: Shared cloud CPU; not student laptop; one BLAS thread.
